prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1154; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a parking lot collision involving two insured vehicles. Claimant reports being struck while backing out of a space. Claimant reports a concussion and has been referred to treatment. Claimant is now represented by counsel, and all further contact is to go through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office to confirm representation and request the medical records authorization form. Office confirmed a signed authorization will follow. Liability appears disputed at this stage, with both parties stating the other vehicle was moving at the time of impact. Scene photos requested from the insured.

Entry 3: Reviewed the police report on the lot collision. The report notes minor body damage to both vehicles and lists no citations issued. Witness statement from a nearby shopper received and filed. Witness places the claimant's vehicle as the one that initiated movement from the parking space.

Entry 4: Received initial treatment records from the claimant's provider, which document a concussion diagnosis and recommend follow-up with a neurologist. Attorney's office requested that the bodily injury evaluation be deferred until the treating physician issues a prognosis. Deferral noted in file. Reserve review scheduled for next cycle.

Entry 5: Attorney's office submitted a demand package including treatment summaries and wage loss documentation. Package forwarded to the claims supervisor for review. Adjuster will coordinate an independent medical review and confirm liability position once the supervisor has responded. No settlement offer to be made until the review is complete.
